system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Run service running a containerized Python 3.12 API.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Run service running a containerized Python 3.12 API.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
imports:
  - path: cloud-run-service.jinja

resources:
  - name: api-service-account
    type: iam.v1.serviceAccount
    properties:
      accountId: cloud-run-api-sa
      displayName: Cloud Run Python API Service Account
      description: Least-privilege service account for Python 3.12 Cloud Run API

  - name: api-sa-logging-binding
    type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
    properties:
      resource: $(ref.api-service-account.projectId)
      role: roles/logging.logWriter
      member: serviceAccount:$(ref.api-service-account.email)

  - name: api-sa-monitoring-binding
    type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
    properties:
      resource: $(ref.api-service-account.projectId)
      role: roles/monitoring.metricWriter
      member: serviceAccount:$(ref.api-service-account.email)

  - name: api-sa-trace-binding
    type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
    properties:
      resource: $(ref.api-service-account.projectId)
      role: roles/cloudtrace.agent
      member: serviceAccount:$(ref.api-service-account.email)

  - name: python-api-service
    type: gcp-types/run-v1:namespaces.services
    metadata:
      dependsOn:
        - api-service-account
        - api-sa-logging-binding
        - api-sa-monitoring-binding
        - api-sa-trace-binding
    properties:
      parent: namespaces/[PROJECT_ID]
      location: us-central1
      apiVersion: serving.knative.dev/v1
      kind: Service
      metadata:
        name: python-api
        namespace: '[PROJECT_ID]'
        annotations:
          run.googleapis.com/ingress: internal-and-cloud-load-balancing
          run.googleapis.com/launch-stage: GA
        labels:
          app: python-api
          environment: production
          managed-by: deployment-manager
      spec:
        template:
          metadata:
            name: python-api-v1
            annotations:
              autoscaling.knative.dev/minScale: '1'
              autoscaling.knative.dev/maxScale: '20'
              run.googleapis.com/execution-environment: gen2
              run.googleapis.com/cpu-throttling: 'true'
              run.googleapis.com/startup-cpu-boost: 'true'
            labels:
              app: python-api
              environment: production
          spec:
            serviceAccountName: $(ref.api-service-account.email)
            containerConcurrency: 80
            timeoutSeconds: 300
            containers:
              - name: python-api
                image: gcr.io/[PROJECT_ID]/python-api:latest
                ports:
                  - name: http1
                    containerPort: 8080
                env:
                  - name: PYTHONUNBUFFERED
                    value: '1'
                  - name: PYTHON_VERSION
                    value: '3.12'
                  - name: PORT
                    value: '8080'
                  - name: ENVIRONMENT
                    value: production
                resources:
                  limits:
                    cpu: '1000m'
                    memory: 512Mi
                  requests:
                    cpu: '500m'
                    memory: 256Mi
                startupProbe:
                  httpGet:
                    path: /healthz
                    port: 8080
                  initialDelaySeconds: 5
                  periodSeconds: 10
                  timeoutSeconds: 3
                  failureThreshold: 3
                livenessProbe:
                  httpGet:
                    path: /healthz
                    port: 8080
                  initialDelaySeconds: 30
                  periodSeconds: 30
                  timeoutSeconds: 3
                  failureThreshold: 3
        traffic:
          - percent: 100
            latestRevision: true

  - name: python-api-iam-policy
    type: gcp-types/run-v1:run.projects.locations.services.setIamPolicy
    metadata:
      dependsOn:
        - python-api-service
    properties:
      resource: projects/[PROJECT_ID]/locations/us-central1/services/python-api
      policy:
        bindings:
          - role: roles/run.invoker
            members:
              - allAuthenticatedUsers

outputs:
  - name: serviceUrl
    value: $(ref.python-api-service.status.url)
  - name: serviceName
    value: $(ref.python-api-service.metadata.name)
  - name: serviceAccountEmail
    value: $(ref.api-service-account.email)
